]

# assign different patterns per helix (varying GC/AU/GU) to reduce cross-helix complementarity
patterns = [
 ['G','C','G','C','G','C','G'],
 ['C','G','C','G'],
 ['G','U','G','C'],
 ['C','A','G','U'],  # will need actual complementary pairing though! Let's just alternate strong/weak with proper WC
]

    seq[j]=comp[letter5]

# helix1 outer len7: GC rich alternating

    assign(0,i,j,h1_letters[k])

# helix2 len4

# helix3 len4

# helix5 len5 (innermost of first branch)
h5_letters=['G','C','A','U','G']
for k,(i,j) in enumerate(helices[4]):

# helix6 len4 (second branch (((( ))))

# helix8 len2 (( ))

# fill unpaired positions with varied non-complementary-prone sequence
